buyr.i1: Posts a detailed search with inspiration photos and a budget
buyr.i2: Receives proposals from findrs who tracked the item down
buyr.i3: Picks the best offer and completes the purchase safely
buyr.i4: Rates the findr on delivery to help the community

findr.title: The findr
findr.intro: The one who goes hunting and digs out the requested piece, wherever it hides.
findr.i1: Browses searches and spots the ones they can deliver on
findr.i2: Hunts actively in flea markets, thrift shops, garage sales, online…

findr.i4: Earns a commission on every successful sale

steps.title: Step by step
steps.showDetails: Show the detail of each step

s1.title: The buyr posts a search
s1.description: A detailed description of the piece, inspiration photos, budget range, urgency level. The sharper the search, the more relevant the proposals.

s2.title: findrs discover and book it
s2.description: findrs browse the open searches. If they believe they can find the item, they can request an exclusive booking to avoid competing while they hunt.

s3.title: The findr sends a proposal
s3.description: Once the item is found, the findr submits a proposal with real photos, the asking price (commission included) and the condition.

s4.title: Negotiation and approval
s4.description: buyr and findr talk through the built-in messaging. The buyr can ask for extra photos, negotiate, or approve the proposal right away.

s5.title: Secure payment
s5.description: The buyr pays securely. Funds are held until the item is received and approved — protection for both sides.

s6.title: Shipping and delivery
s6.description: The findr ships the item with tracking. On arrival, the buyr confirms everything matches. The funds are then released to the findr.

s7.title: Mutual rating
s7.description: Both sides rate each other. Those reviews build reputation and trust across the community.

reservation.title: The booking system
reservation.why1: Avoid several findrs hunting the same item
reservation.why2: Invest time in the hunt with peace of mind
reservation.how1: The findr requests a booking for a set duration
reservation.how2: The buyr approves, adjusts or declines the request
reservation.how3: The search becomes exclusive for that duration

fees.title: Platform fees
fees.intro: findr charges a commission shared between both parties to maintain the platform, secure payments and support the community.
fees.standardText: added to the item price at checkout.
fees.premiumText: deducted from the amount paid to the findr, for a total commission of 8%.
fees.example: Example: for a €50 item, the buyr pays €52 and the findr receives €48.

etiquette.title: findr good manners
etiquette.intro: A few simple rules to keep the experience great for everyone.

r1.title: Respect and kindness
r1.description: Every member deserves respect. Keep exchanges courteous, even when you disagree.

r2.title: Clear communication
r2.description: Reply to messages within a reasonable window (24-48h). Be precise in your descriptions.

r3.title: Honesty
r3.description: Describe item condition faithfully. Bad surprises damage everyone's trust.

r4.title: Reliability
r4.description: Honour your commitments: booking, shipping and reply times. Speak up if something comes up.

r5.title: Fair ratings
r5.description: Rate constructively. A negative review should be justified and factual.

r6.title: No off-platform deals
r6.description: Every transaction must go through findr so everyone stays protected.

privacy.intro: This policy describes the processing of personal data carried out in connection with the use of the Findr platform.

data.title: 2. Data processed

transfers.title: 4. Transfers outside the European Union
transfers.text: Lovable Labs Incorporated, a US company incorporated in Delaware, governs data transfers through its Data Processing Agreement, which provides for the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), rather than the Data Privacy Framework.

retention.title: 5. Retention periods
retention.text: Retention periods vary according to the purpose of the processing and are not uniformly set at ten years. Accounting data is retained for the applicable statutory period.

rights.title: 6. Your rights
rights.text: You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability. You may exercise them by emailing <email>contact@findrapp.fr</email>. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (<cnil>www.cnil.fr</cnil>).

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of the Findr platform. They must be read together with the Terms and Conditions of Sale and the Privacy Policy.

purpose.title: Article 1 — Publisher and purpose
purpose.text: FINDR APP SAS operates a digital platform that allows one user (the “Buyr”) to publish a search for an item and another user (the “Findr”) to propose a matching item. Findr provides features for connecting users, transactions, tracking and claims management.

definitions.title: Article 2 — Definitions
definitions.text: Platform (the Findr website, application and services); Buyr (a user who publishes a Search or purchases an item); Findr (a user who proposes an item in response to a Search); Search (a request published by a Buyr); Proposal (an offer from a Findr including a description, price and delivery terms).

registration.title: Article 3 — Registration
registration.text: Registration is restricted to adults with legal capacity. Accurate and up-to-date information is required.

matching.title: Article 4 — How it works
matching.text: The Buyr publishes a Search, one or more Findrs may submit a Proposal, and acceptance initiates the transaction process in accordance with the Terms and Conditions of Sale.

role.title: Article 5 — FINDR's role
role.text: FINDR operates the marketplace and plays an active role in the transaction journey (presentation of offers, arrangement of payment through its provider, tracking, management of the conditions for releasing funds, and handling of claims). FINDR's designation as “merchant of record” within its Stripe environment does not, in itself, mean that FINDR is the legal seller of each item—the seller's identity and capacity are displayed to the Buyr before the sale.

obligations.title: Article 6 — User obligations
obligations.text: Users undertake not to provide misleading information, not to offer unlawful, counterfeit or dangerous goods, to describe the item accurately, to respect third-party intellectual property rights, and not to circumvent the Platform.

content.title: Article 7 — Content
content.text: Users grant FINDR a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide licence to the content they publish.

reviews.title: Article 8 — Reviews
reviews.text: A review may be published after a transaction. FINDR may remove content that is manifestly unlawful.

suspension.title: Article 9 — Suspension
suspension.text: An account may be suspended in the event of a breach of the Terms of Use or Terms and Conditions of Sale, fraud, or a security risk. Any measures taken will be proportionate.

personalData.title: Article 10 — Personal data
personalData.text: The processing of personal data is described in our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

changes.title: Article 11 — Changes to the Terms of Use
changes.text: FINDR may amend these Terms of Use for a legitimate reason.

law.title: Article 12 — Governing law
law.text: These Terms of Use are governed by French law, subject to mandatory consumer protection provisions.
